pages.title: Packed with Care
pages.text: Let a backpack Feeding Upgrade actually restore hunger using eligible stored food.

pages.title: Packed with Care
pages.text: Let supplies care for the player; Advanced Feeding refines feeding timing and chocolate prepares the next outing.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Filters and hunger thresholds control feeding. Alchemy separately uses potions, effect-food or milk; advanced filters effects. This does not imply villagers can eat from every backpack.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Feeding consumes eligible backpack food for its player; configure filter/hunger threshold, with additional advanced timing options.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Alchemy automatically uses eligible potions, effect-food or milk from the backpack. Set conditions/filter; advanced filters effects without overriding native effect rules.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Storage Feeding/Alchemy consume eligible food/potions for nearby real players under wrapper rules, not universal villager feeding from every chest.
